subject.title: fix(crestodian): keep onboarding connected through restart

question: Should this PR land with the profile-aware approval migration boundary and Crestodian RPC drain behavior as written, or wait for additional packaged upgrade proof?
rationale: The patch appears correct, but it changes startup migration behavior for approval state and touches the first-run macOS Gateway onboarding path, both of which are compatibility- and security-sensitive surfaces under repository policy.

options.title: Land with current proof
options.body: Accept the included tests and PR-body packaged validation as sufficient for the narrow migration and onboarding fixes.

options.title: Request one more packaged trace
options.body: Ask for attached redacted macOS packaged-run output showing setup completion survives restart and named-profile default approvals remain untouched.

options.title: Pause for migration owner review
options.body: Hold the PR until a state-migration owner explicitly confirms the profile-versus-relocation boundary.

recommendation.title: Land with current proof
recommendation.body: Accept the included tests and PR-body packaged validation as sufficient for the narrow migration and onboarding fixes.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns this PR, opened the linked reports, and has prior history in the affected onboarding and approval-state surfaces.
